title: grade parcel single crossing
description:
The flat 41/43/42/44-parameter grade doors died with their
Kotlin decls and their JNIEXPORT bodies; the parcel twins are the
ONLY doors across the seam now.

- dispatch sites: ClipEditorScreen encodes the parcel per preview
  request, after the temporalNr tier fold (grade.copy inside the
  encode, so the fold rides the parcel); Mp4Exporter encodes ONCE
  per export before the frame loop and passes the same array to
  both GPU twins; the CPU export path rides jniExportFrameParcel
  too, so both consumers read the SAME wire format.
- the C++ sessions' flat pre-folded overloads are deleted; the
  struct-taking (req, grade) entries are the only doors, each
  folding via the GENERATED applyGradeToRequest onto a stack copy
  (impl_->pendingReq = &folded).
- fakes decode with the REAL GradeParcel.decode, so the
  pass-through locks assert the same wire format the bridge reads;
  the decode-refu
